summary: Andretti Acquisition Corp. II, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K disclosing an additional non-redemption agreement with a new unaffiliated investor, supplementing six prior agreements signed August 28 through September 4, 2026. Investors holding up to 6,348,959 public Class A shares agreed not to redeem, in exchange for up to 1,587,240 Pubco shares if a business combination closes by June 9, 2027, plus 529,080 more if later. The new investor covers 162,500 Pubco shares pre-June 2027 and 54,167 after. No target, terms, or board recommendation given. Watch redemption levels and deal timing risk.
